snippet.title: Looking For Fael trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Hello, this is Fael... Listen, this is going to sound strange, but... I think I'm lost in the apartment. Right now... I... I don't know where I am. Can you come and help me?

Looking For Fael by Swing Swing Submarine, La Poule Noire, and @arte comes out this year!
